note: Gated, treed RV park on the north shore of Hastings Lake in the Beaver Hills Biosphere, Strathcona County, ~45 minutes east of Edmonton; mostly seasonal sites, with a few sold by the night. Natural sandy beach, two lakeside cottages and a picnic area; no parties or groups of campers. Paid sewage pump-out at the site. --Claude
summary: Good Sam engine sells one night (May 2027: 15 A C$50, 30 A C$55, +C$8 extra person), season May 5 - Sep 30; water at sites, no sewer (stored sewer true corrected); website still says 2025 season and posts no rates; heavily seasonal with a site-ownership (condo) plan; Google 3.8 from 84 reviews = drop candidate.
